[[Timothy Flenning|Timothy]] (brother) }} '''Sara Flenning''' was a human woman from [[Northwind]], where she lived with her mother [[Judith Flenning|Judith]] and brother [[Timothy Flenning|Timothy]]. While Judith was away from the house, she and Timothy were kidnapped{{questlong|Alliance|28|Empty Houses}} by orcs of the [[Stormreaver clan]] that sought to take them to their hideout on the island of [[Balor]]. Sara was killed by the Stormreavers before she could be rescued, and her body was later retrieved by [[Operative Baltimore Hawthorne]] of [[SI:7]].{{questlong|Alliance|34|Shadow's Vision}} ==Quotes== The young woman lies motionless on the ground.
